## Summary

Describe the problem and the change. Link an issue if one exists.

## Affected workflow

Review / Association / Research Event Engine / Data / Training / Documentation

## Verification

List exact commands, results and skipped checks. For model/video tests include
configuration and fixture identifiers; do not upload private artifacts.

## Compatibility

Does this change a schema, threshold, API, stored output, or dependency?
Explain migration or confirm that existing behaviour is preserved.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and documentation is updated.
- [ ] Local tests and documentation links were checked.
- [ ] No credentials, signed links, weights, datasets, or generated runtime files.
- [ ] Claims distinguish software tests from model/tracking/event quality.
- [ ] Runtime-specific event semantics and human-review history are preserved.
